provenance.dataset: SoilGrids mean, 5th and 95th percentile maps, 0-30 cm depth-weighted
provenance.units: pH; organic carbon g/kg; clay, sand, silt %
provenance.period: 0-5, 5-15 and 15-30 cm layers weighted by thickness
provenance.note: A machine-learning prediction of soil properties, not a measurement of this field. The 5th-95th range shows its uncertainty.

gaps: No soil is mapped at the exact point (towns, water and ice are masked). Using the nearest mapped land 2 km away.
